title: Getting a Grip
heading: Getting a Grip

structureSummary.part1: show hands and fingers as expressive confidence and stress surfaces
structureSummary.part2: map open palms, hiding, interlacing, rubbing, and self-soothing
structureSummary.part3: keep all hand readings contextual and modest

usageRules: Paraphrase-first. Support hands and fingers as signals of confidence, stress, soothing, emphasis, and restraint. Do not claim one hand cue proves honesty, deceit, dominance, or trust.
